title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 499. for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the billing months of December, 1986, January and February 1987. The Oil Conservation Adjustment charge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired generation and its calculation is based on the repective costs of burining coal and oil.
